item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pas rab brtan phag lo'i sbas pa'i rang bzhin shar phyogs dbang phyug ri bo'i byang phyogs nyi ma rang shar gnas kyi g.yon phyogs seng gdong phug tu zla 8tshes la/ rigs mthun gyi grogs bcas te khrom gter du bgyis shing / slar zla tshes rang la bsod nams stobs kyi rgyal po sa skyongs chen po'i pho brang drug zur rnam rgyal rdzong gi dbus rtse la shog ser bod yig tu phab pa'o//
